purpose: Neutral overhead grass and earth plate shared by ten representative tactical boards. Scenario-specific geography is drawn from the same zones and road bands used by the simulation.
promptSummary: Straight overhead 1860s eastern American pasture, worn grass and earth, quiet natural variation, no horizon, sky, buildings, soldiers, roads, text or flags.
flags: New v4 scenarios use symbolic Union blue and Confederate red standards, not claims of exact regimental flags. Gettysburg v3 keeps its existing period-inspired flags.
limitations: Representative game coordinates, not surveyed battle maps.
Trees and ridge contours illustrate the authored cover zones; exact zone boundaries are available with Terrain rules.
Original scenario paintings remain available for older battle rules.
